fullPassage: The children of genius parents are probably going to be less intelligent than their moms and dads. A week of record-breaking heat or cold is likely to be followed by milder weather. These facts follow directly from the nature of numbers, but people do not appreciate the statistical basis and instead tend to formulate special causal explanations. During a dry spell, if you do a rain dance every day, sooner or later the rain will come — and you may be tempted to think that your rain dance did the trick. (The illusion works especially well if you change your rain dance a bit each day, when it didn't work, so that when it finally rains, you think, At last, I got it right!) Medicine and psychotherapy thrive on regression to the mean. Whenever you feel bad, the odds are that you will feel better in a few days, and if you visit a physician in the interim, you will probably give her credit for your improvement. (And the doctor probably will be willing to accept your gratitude!)

questions.passage: And the doctor probably will be __________ (will) to accept your gratitude!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: be + 형용사 + to부정사 구문. '기꺼이 ~하다'는 be willing to. 조동사 will이 아니라 형용사 willing으로 변환해야 문법적으로 올바름

questions.passage: The children of genius parents are probably going to be less intelligent than their moms and dads. A week of record-breaking heat or cold is likely to be followed by milder weather. These facts follow directly from the nature of numbers, but people do not appreciate the statistical basis and instead tend to formulate special causal explanations. During a dry spell, if you do a rain dance every day, sooner or later the rain will come — and you may be tempted to think that your rain dance did the trick. (The illusion works especially well if you change your rain dance a bit each day, when it didn't work, so that when it finally rains, you think, At last, I got it right!) Medicine and psychotherapy thrive on __________. Whenever you feel bad, the odds are that you will feel better in a few days, and if you visit a physician in the interim, you will probably give her credit for your improvement. (And the doctor probably will be willing to accept your gratitude!)
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 의학과 심리치료가 평균 회귀에 힘입어 번성한다는 맥락
det.analysis:
① regression to the mean: 평균 회귀 — 의학과 심리치료가 이것에 힘입어 번성한다 ←정답

② record-breaking heat: 기록적 더위 — 의학과 무관한 날씨 표현

③ the nature of numbers: 수의 본질 — 사실이 이것에서 비롯되지만 의학 번성의 원인 아님

④ a rain dance: 비의 춤 — 미신적 행위 예시로 의학과 무관

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 사람들이 통계적 근거 대신 특별한 인과적 설명을 만들어 낸다는 맥락
det.analysis:
① the nature of numbers: 수의 본질 — 사실이 이것에서 비롯되는 맥락이지 formulate의 목적어 아님

② record-breaking heat: 기록적 더위 — 날씨 예시이지 사람들이 만들어내는 것 아님

③ a dry spell: 가뭄 — 비의 춤 예시의 배경이지 formulate의 목적어 부적합

④ special causal explanations: 특별한 인과적 설명 — 통계적 근거를 인식하지 못하고 대신 만들어 냄 ←정답
